source_code_causal_chain: _local_apt_executable_evidence first requires a goal term to appear in an /usr/bin command filename before a package can enter executable evidence.
Remote manpage semantic enrichment is applied only after that filename-gated preliminary set is built and truncated.
search_apt_packages separately creates package-description candidates, but final _apt_rank_key gives all direct executable semantic/path evidence categorical priority over catalog-only candidates.
Therefore semantic package metadata can be present yet unable to rescue semantically opaque executable names, while incidental filename matches dominate final recall.

external_existing_mechanism_evidence.evidence: Ubuntu 24.04 Noble ships apt-xapian-index 0.54ubuntu1. It indexes Debian/Ubuntu package information for relevance-ranked search.
Existing axi-cache uses English stemming, spelling correction, AUTO_SYNONYMS, boolean query parsing, and relevance ordering.
Package descriptions/tags directly encode task semantics and command-line/program role for examples such as tesseract-ocr and optipng.
apt-file supports list/show package and --from-file batching, so executable presence can be verified after semantic retrieval instead of used as the semantic generator.
